# bitbucket_current_user (Data Source)

Looks up the Bitbucket Cloud account authenticated by the provider's credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bitbucket_current_user" "me" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Atlassian account ID of the authenticated user.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the authenticated user.
- `id` (String) Identifier (the user's UUID).
- `nickname` (String) Nickname of the authenticated user.
- `username` (String) Username, if the account still has one.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the authenticated user.
